sanskrit:
निश्चयं श‍ृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम ।
त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः ॥ १८-४॥
iast:
niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama
tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ 18-4
translation: Hear from Me the conclusion or the final truth, about this abandonment O best of the Bharatas; abandonment verily, O best of men, has been declared to be of three kinds.
